seoTitle: Christmas Cruises Manchester 2026 | Manchester River Cruises
seoDescription: Festive cruises on the Manchester Ship Canal. Christmas party nights, mulled wine, and live entertainment on the water. Book now — dates sell out fast.
heading: Christmas Cruises Manchester
intro: Three ways to celebrate on the Manchester Ship Canal this December — a decked-out party night, your own private do, or a Santa cruise for the family.
keyFacts: Party nights, private hire & Santa cruises

sections.heading: What's Christmas like on the water?
Party nights, dressed for Christmas
body: We don’t run separate “Christmas specials” — we don’t need to. Every one of our regular party nights runs right through December with the full festive treatment: the boat decorated bow to stern, festive extras on board, and Christmas songs woven into the set. Whether it’s ABBA, Dolly, Elvis or a soul night, you get the same great cruise with all the Christmas sparkle on top.

sections.heading: Your own Christmas party
body: The office Christmas do, sorted. Take the whole boat and it’s exclusively yours for the night — decorated for Christmas, with a licensed bar, a dancefloor and Manchester’s floodlit waterfront as your backdrop. It’s the highest-impact way to celebrate a team or a big group, and it beats booking out the same tired function room.
sections.note: Catering, drinks packages and festive extras — TBC from Simon (content-checklist.md).

sections.heading: Santa cruises
body: Our one truly Christmas-specific event. Little ones meet Father Christmas on the water, in a warm, festively decorated cabin, with a gift for every child — plus a sensory-friendly SEN Santa cruise for children with additional needs.

sections.heading: Christmas on board
body: Real festive moments on the water — tap to browse

sections.heading: Can’t pick a date? Give a voucher
body: A gift voucher is the easy Christmas present — they pick the cruise and the date that suits them. Redeemable against any sailing.

cards.name: Party nights, dressed for Christmas
cards.desc: All our regular party nights — ABBA, Dolly, Elvis, Soul and more — get the full Christmas treatment through December: the boat decorated bow to stern, festive extras on board and Christmas songs in the mix. Same great nights, in full festive dress.

cards.name: Your own Christmas party
cards.desc: The whole boat, exclusively yours — the standout way to do the office Christmas do or a big group celebration. Your own decorated boat, your own night on the water, with a licensed bar and the floodlit waterfront gliding past. December dates go fast, so get yours locked in.

cards.name: Santa cruises
cards.desc: The one truly Christmas-specific event: a magical family cruise where little ones meet Father Christmas himself on the water, with a festively decorated cabin and a gift for every child. Pure festive magic for the countdown to Christmas.

items.question: Do you run special Christmas events?
items.answer: Our regular party nights run right through December with the full Christmas treatment — the boat decorated bow to stern, festive extras on board and Christmas songs mixed into the night. The one Christmas-specific event is our family Santa cruise. For a do of your own, hire the whole boat.

items.question: Can I book a private Christmas party?
items.answer: Yes — hire the whole boat for your office party or group celebration, with the boat decorated for Christmas. Catering, drinks packages and festive extras — TBC from Simon. Enquire via our private hire page; December books up early.

items.question: When should I book for December?
items.answer: December is our busiest month and party nights and private dates sell out, so book as early as you can. Exact deadlines — TBC.

items.question: What should I wear?
items.answer: Dress warmly (and festively!). There is a heated indoor cabin, but the open deck can be cold in winter. (TBC)

items.question: Are the Christmas cruises accessible?
items.answer: Step-free boarding is available where tides allow, and our sensory-friendly SEN Santa cruise is designed for children with additional needs. Full accessibility details — TBC.
